snippet.title: GemLoop - Official Release Trailer | Out Now on Steam!
snippet.description:
Match, upgrade, and grow your way through GemLoop - a colorful Match-3 incremental puzzle game where every match brings you closer to something bigger! Start with a small board, earn gold, unlock powerful upgrades, and watch your gameplay evolve as your board expands and new possibilities emerge.

Developed entirely in Godot as a solo indie project.

Available NOW on Steam!

Get GemLoop on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5296420/GemLoop/

If you enjoy Match-3 puzzles, incremental progression, and satisfying chain reactions, GemLoop might be just what you're looking for!

Every purchase, review, and bit of feedback means a lot. Thank you for supporting indie game development!

#GemLoop #IndieGame #Match3 #IncrementalGame #SteamGames
